headword: {折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}
gloss: shuttle operation; partial operation with turnback

definitions.gloss: shuttle operation; partial operation with turnback (trains, buses)
definitions.explanation: The practice of operating trains or buses only along part of a line and turning them back before the usual terminus, typically because a section further along is blocked by an accident, weather, or other disruption.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the accident, the line is running on shuttle operation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦{区間|くかん}→区間：18759_kukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}になった。
examples.english: Due to the heavy rain, part of the line went to shuttle operation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{品川|しながわ}→品川：30707_shinagawa⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Shuttle service is continuing between Tokyo Station and Shinagawa Station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{信号|しんごう}{故障|こしょう}→信号故障：08698_shingoukoshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{新宿|しんじゅく}→新宿：30634_shinjuku⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実施|じっし}しています→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧。
examples.english: Due to a signal malfunction, we are operating shuttle service turning back at Shinjuku Station.

notes:
Composed of {折返|おりかえ}し (turning back, U-turn) + ⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧ (operation). A standard railway-announcement term in Japan used when a portion of a line is blocked and trains cannot run through to the normal terminus. Trains are instead operated back and forth between an intermediate station and one endpoint.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実施|じっし}する→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧: to operate shuttle service
- {折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to go to shuttle operation
- {折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}⟦{区間|くかん}→区間：18759_kukan⟧: section under shuttle operation
- {折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}{中|ちゅう}: currently operating shuttle service

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{運休|うんきゅう}→運休：06807_unkyuu⟧: service suspension — no trains running at all
- ⟦{間引|まび}き{運転|うんてん}→間引き運転：23320_mabikiunten⟧: reduced service — fewer trains, not a turnback
- ⟦{直通|ちょくつう}→直通：13653_chokutsuu⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧: through operation — the normal, full-route operation; the opposite concept
- ⟦{平常|へいじょう}→平常：25319_heijou⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧: normal operation — the baseline

USAGE:
Heard frequently in Japanese train-line status updates ("⟦{山手線|やまのてせん}→山手線：30709_yamanotesen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実施|じっし}しています→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧"). Passengers may need to change trains or use alternative routes beyond the turnback point.
